subject: Speculative application: graduate civil engineer or civil designer, Marc Darenz Masarate
email_body:
Hi Price Merrett team,

This is a speculative application, sent because your careers page says you want to hear from people looking to join the team. I'm looking for a graduate civil engineer or civil designer place.

I completed an Advanced Diploma of Civil Construction Design in February 2026, covering road geometry, earthworks, pavement and stormwater drainage in Civil 3D and AutoCAD, and I hold a civil engineering degree from the Philippines. In 2019 and 2020 I worked on site there as a project-in-charge engineer and then a field engineer on residential subdivision finishing works. I live in Melton, hold a White Card and an Australian driver's licence, and have full working rights on a Subclass 485 visa until December 2027. I'm available for regional work and open to discussing relocation to Kerang, Mildura or Swan Hill.

Your infrastructure team designs council roads, kerb and channel and subdivisions, which is the work I trained for. I haven't worked in Australian consulting yet, so I would start under supervision.

Would you keep me in mind for a graduate role, or be open to a short chat? I've attached my resume and cover letter.

Marc Darenz Masarate
0478 764 077
macdarenz@gmail.com

paragraphs: This is a speculative application for a graduate civil engineer or civil designer place at Price Merrett Consulting. Your careers page says you want to hear from people who want to join a consultancy where fresh ideas are welcomed, so I am writing to you directly.

I completed an Advanced Diploma of Civil Construction Design at Albright Institute in February 2026. My coursework covered road geometry, earthworks, pavement systems and stormwater drainage, with drawings prepared and reviewed in AutoCAD and Civil 3D against Australian Standards. I also lodged Before You Dig Australia enquiries and designed around existing services and site constraints. Before coming to Australia I completed a Bachelor of Science in Civil Engineering in the Philippines.

From April 2019 to February 2020 I worked on site in the Philippines, first as a project-in-charge engineer on a community hall renovation and then as a field engineer on residential subdivision finishing works. I carried out site inspections and quality checks and prepared site reports, material records and progress reports.

Your council road and subdivision design work, from kerb and channel to roundabouts and car parks, is the kind of work I want to learn. I have not yet worked in Australian consulting, so I would expect to learn under supervision. I hold a White Card and an Australian driver's licence, have full working rights on a Subclass 485 visa until December 2027, and I am open to discussing relocation to Kerang, Mildura or Swan Hill.
Thank you for reading this. I've attached my resume and cover letter, and my portfolio is at https://macdarenz-droid.github.io/Portfolio
